# IoT Edge Gateway Mesh

## Overview
Edge telemetry ingestion system for logistics tracking and fleet sensors.
Documentation: [Edge Architecture](https://example.com/edge-mesh)

## Telemetry Ingestion
- MQTT over TLS 1.3 protocol termination at regional point-of-presence gateways.
- FIFO buffer queues absorbing bursty telematics packets prior to database ingestion.

## Edge Buffer Queues
Partitioned Kafka streams partitioned by vehicle_id ensuring strict causal message ordering.
Scale Hint: 5,000,000 connected devices reporting at 10-second intervals.

## Security Isolation
Mutual TLS (mTLS) with per-device X.509 client certificates and automated CRL revocation.
